backend/main.mo: Backend canister implementing authorization, user profiles, and persistent media publishing with admin‑restricted setters for hero background, images, videos, and background song.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping specific frontend files to media‑handling, rendering, and behavior requirements with associated components and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of all major frontend components, hooks, configs, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions configuring a light/dark romantic color palette and global styling rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining root mount element and loading the main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/public/PLACEHOLDER_MEDIA_README: Developer notes explaining uploaded‑only media rules, empty‑state behavior, and how to use the in‑app Media Manager.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app wiring authentication, intro popup, media sections, popups, and ambient animations within the MediaStoreProvider.
frontend/src/components/FlipImageCard.ts: 3D flip‑card component that toggles between an eagerly‑loaded image and a message with accessibility and optional transform support.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHearts.t: Ambient animation component rendering floating heart emojis with randomized timing and positions.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Displays the hero section with optional background image, decorative text, and a media manager button.
frontend/src/components/ImageAdjustModal: Provides a modal to zoom, pan, and reset an image before saving its transform settings.
frontend/src/components/ImageMemorySecti: Renders a grid of memory images using stored order, transforms, and flip cards with romantic messages.
frontend/src/components/IntroPopup.tsx: Shows an introductory popup overlay with a decorative message and a close button.
frontend/src/components/LockScreen.tsx: Implements a password lock screen with error feedback and an unlock callback.
Displays a scrollable popup that types out a long love letter with a close button.
frontend/src/components/MediaManager.tsx: Manages uploading, previewing, adjusting, and publishing hero images, gallery media, and song/video files with draft state and precheck logic.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Audio player component with autoplay handling, play/pause toggle, and mobile tap prompt.
frontend/src/components/ProposalPopup.ts: Full-screen modal showing a romantic proposal message with animated visuals and close controls.
frontend/src/components/RosePetals.tsx: Displays falling petal emojis using randomized positions and animation timing.
Section with two buttons that trigger opening a love letter or proposal popup.
frontend/src/components/VideoMemorySecti: Video gallery showing up to six uploaded videos with mute toggle and empty-slot states.
frontend/src/config/imageMemory.ts: Generates 43 image memory entries, each paired with a rotating romantic message.
frontend/src/config/romanticMessages.ts: Array of customizable romantic messages used for image memory cards.
frontend/src/config/videoMemory.ts: Defines configuration for six video memory slots.
frontend/src/context/MediaStoreContext.t: Context managing all media URLs, uploads, state syncing with backend, and media ordering.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous actor, refreshing dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, handling login, stored identities, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaDraft.ts: Manages a media draft state with images, videos, hero image, ordering, transforms, and drag interactions.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaStore.ts: Re-exports the MediaStore context hook for accessing media-related state and actions.
frontend/src/hooks/usePublishWithPrechec: Handles pre-publish checks and publishing media with backend diagnostics, managing status and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionGate.ts: Implements a simple password gate stored in sessionStorage to unlock a session.
frontend/src/hooks/useTypingText.ts: Creates a typing animation effect that reveals text over time and tracks completion.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind setup, theme variables, animations, and UI styles including romantic visual effects and flip-card styling.
frontend/src/lib/deployDiagnostics.ts: Provides utilities to normalize, stringify, and format diagnostic errors for logging and user-facing messages.
frontend/src/lib/localMediaStore.ts: IndexedDB-based storage layer for saving, retrieving, listing, and clearing locally persisted media blobs by slot type/index.
frontend/src/lib/mediaDiagnostics.ts: Defines diagnostic types and logs structured media-related state and submit summaries to console.
frontend/src/lib/publishedMediaClient.ts: Handles uploading or clearing hero, image, video, and song media to the backend with slot validation and optional progress callbacks.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React root with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the App.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining themes, colors, animations, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Describes project architecture, features, known issues, and requirements for a React + IC canister media application.
